hazards.description: The Misty Mountains rise before you. The path winds up and down through rocky passes.
hazards.name: Misty Mountain Pass

hazards.description: The Dead Marshes stretch out, a maze of stagnant pools and treacherous ground. Slow going.
hazards.name: Dead Marshes

hazards.description: A sudden storm rolls in from the east. Sheets of rain hammer down.
hazards.name: Sudden Storm
